{{Quote|Koy'tiffin. Twi'lek actress born about sixty years ago. Early in her career she did the usual range of beautiful-Twi'lek holodrama roles&mdash;slave dancers, hopeful young entertainers, fatal females. Later she concentrated more on stage work. Still acts.|Thaymes Fodrick|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Koy'tiffin''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was both a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] and stage [[Actor/Legends|actress]]. Early in her career she performed a variety of Twi'lek holodrama roles that [[Thaymes Fodrick]] described as including [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancers, hopeful young entertainers, and fatal females. Later in her career, she concentrated more on stage work.<ref name="MK" />
